title: Sergey Brin Wants Google to Double Down on Gemini. What That Means for GOOGL Stock.
excerpt: Co-founder Sergey Brin wants Google to keep improving Gemini capabilities.
content_html:
Anushka Dutta

Sat, August 15, 2026 at 1:00 PM EDT 4 min read

Alphabet's (GOOGL) Google co-founder Sergey Brin has urged its parent company to focus more on its proprietary LLM Gemini. The report also indicates that Google's executives have taken a more hands-on approach to directing its AI operations. 

Google has recently announced that its AI wing will have a new boss. DeepMind, Google's AI unit, CEO Demis Hassabis will step down, with Koray Kavukcuoglu, previously the AI unit's CTO and Google's chief AI architect, taking over as SVP. This is a strategic choice as Google faces intense pressure from OpenAI and Anthropic. Anthropic's Mythos model and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 have been lauded, but since the Gemini 3.1 Pro launch, no subsequent Alphabet releases have challenged the AI firms so far.

Kavukcuoglu will oversee Gemini's development and its app and developer teams. This aligns with Brin's vision of improving Gemini's capabilities, as coding becomes increasingly important in developing frontier AI. Google reported that Gemini models now process 22 billion API tokens per minute and the Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users. 

About Google Stock

Alphabet, the American multinational technology conglomerate and parent company of Google, is headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company is aggressively expanding its artificial intelligence operations, centralizing AI leadership and development at its main campus to accelerate progress against rivals. It has committed to massive future spending, mostly on AI infrastructure, to power its next-generation models and products. Alphabet has a market capitalization of $4.236 trillion. 

Investors are optimistic about Google's position in the AI landscape (although they are not happy about the hefty spending), and Google Cloud has become a growth engine for the company. Over the past 52 weeks, GOOGL's stock has gained 70.44%, while it is up 10.51% year-to-date (YTD). It reached a 52-week high of $408.61 on May 18, but is down 15.4% from that level. 

For a company of its stature, GOOGL's valuation does not feel overly stretched compared to its peers. Its forward-adjusted price-to-earnings ratio of 16.75 times sits higher than the industry average of 13.12 times.

安努舒卡·杜塔

2026 年 8 月 15 日星期六，美国东部时间下午 1:00 阅读 4 分钟

Alphabet（GOOGL）谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林（Sergey Brin）敦促其母公司更多地关注其专有的法学硕士双子座（LLM Gemini）。 该报告还表明，谷歌高管采取了更加亲力亲为的方式来指导其人工智能业务。

谷歌最近宣布其人工智能部门将有一位新老板。 谷歌人工智能部门 DeepMind 首席执行官 Demis Hassabis 将辞职，该人工智能部门前 CTO、谷歌首席人工智能架构师 Koray Kavukcuoglu 接任高级副总裁。 这是谷歌面临 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 巨大压力时的战略选择。 Anthropic 的 Mythos 模型和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 备受赞誉，但自 Gemini 3.1 Pro 发布以来，迄今为止还没有后续的 Alphabet 版本对人工智能公司构成挑战。

Kavukcuoglu 将监督 Gemini 的开发及其应用程序和开发团队。 这与布林提高 Gemini 能力的愿景一致，因为编码在开发前沿人工智能中变得越来越重要。 谷歌报告称，Gemini 模型现在每分钟处理 220 亿个 API 令牌，Gemini App 每月有 9.5 亿活跃用户。

关于谷歌股票

Alphabet 是美国跨国科技集团，也是谷歌的母公司，总部位于加利福尼亚州山景城。 该公司正在积极扩展其人工智能业务，将人工智能领导和开发集中在其主园区，以加快与竞争对手的竞争。 该公司已承诺未来进行大量支出，主要是在人工智能基础设施上，为其下一代模型和产品提供动力。 Alphabet 的市值为 4.236 万亿美元。

投资者对谷歌在人工智能领域的地位持乐观态度（尽管他们对巨额支出并不满意），而谷歌云已经成为该公司的增长引擎。 过去 52 周，GOOGL 的股价上涨了 70.44%，年初至今 (YTD) 上涨了 10.51%。 5 月 18 日触及 408.61 美元的 52 周高点，但较该水平下跌 15.4%。

对于一家具有如此地位的公司来说，与同行相比，GOOGL 的估值并没有显得过高。 其远期调整市盈率为16.75倍，高于行业平均水平13.12倍。
